## Plugin reference

- Description: Isle's index pane (/isle): the island drawn by the canvas engine from the listed apps and the stored plots (apps without a plot placed by the pure world and claimed), with the title card (Start held back while the world loads), the where-chip, the prompt card for the building at the hero's door (E opens it), the iris an app opens through (useActivateApp), drag-and-drop of buildings (the move endpoint), the time of day from the clock or the config, and a visually hidden list of links mirroring the buildings. Server registration of the Isle config (seed, time of day, music).
- Web:
  - Slots: `isle.actions`
  - Slot contributors: `isle.actions` ← `primitives.pane`
  - Contributes:
    - `Pane.Register` "isle"
    - `ConfigV2.WebRegister` "isle"
  - Uses: 30 symbols — full list in [REFERENCE.md](./REFERENCE.md)
